displacement.ref: phono3py default distance (systematic and random); phononDB-LTC random sets use 0.03

fit_cutoffs.ref: heuristic: symfc FC3 pair cutoffs; snapshots are sized for the largest, kappa at the smallest is the cutoff-convergence check (plan §9.2 basis-size table)

fc3_snapshot_factor.ref: phono3py 3.30.0 generate_displacements(number_of_snapshots='auto'): symfc minimum x 4 for FC3

learning_curve_fraction.ref: heuristic: kappa from this fraction of the FC3 snapshots is the snapshot-count check

random_seed.ref: fixed so the approved displacement set is reproducible

fc2_supercell_shape.ref: decided 11-07: the MLIP path takes the smallest FC2 cell of any shape (GPU memory), but random FC2 displacements at the symfc minimum x 2 gave imaginary modes in a symmetry-broken cell (EMT Cu3Au); DFT keeps the point group
